what_it_does: Add one bomb. Throw with G; detonates immediately for up to 85 damage within 5 units.
model_description: Round dark cartoon bomb with a short glowing fuse.
notes: Enemy damage falls to 45% at the blast edge. Self-damage: 20 within 3 units. Separate consumable counter.

what_it_does: Unlock all entrances to one item room or shop. Look at its padlock and press F; consumes one key.
model_description: Oversized golden key with a paw-shaped bow.
notes: Adds one stored key. One key unlocks a whole room for the current floor. Runs begin with one key; every second combat clear awards another.
